title: 5 stars with teenagers
text: Authentic and intimate. Inside a cave in Albacin. Performed by gypsies. Live guitar and dancing. Worth the price.
author: CJ_V

title: A beautiful and meaningful flamenco experience
text:
I was truly amazed by my experience at Cueva Zincalé. The dancers were powerful and full of feeling, the guitarist was excellent, and the singing was passionate and unforgettable. It felt like a real and authentic flamenco performance.

I also appreciated how punctual and well organised everything was, which made the whole evening smooth and enjoyable.

For me, this was not only entertainment. It helped me understand more of Andalusia, its history, its music, and the emotion behind this art. It gave me a deeper personal connection to Granada and to Andalusian culture as a whole.
